title: Deeper/broader 3D writer failure evidence and acceptance-harness boundary
scope: Refresh OpenCADStudio's current release/source/automation route and codec/kernel lineage
Inspect peer issue evidence for AcDs-backed DWG 3D writer failures
Refine existing carrier, per-solid disposition, external-open, and semantic acceptance boundaries
Keep implementation cadence, fixtures, dependencies, and external-J promotion unchanged

method.kind: Read-only review of public primary repository, release, automation, and issue pages
method.limitations: Project source/docs are mutable and do not prove the exact behavior of a released executable. Issue #225 does not expose a hash-bound drawing or visible fix/closure evidence in the reviewed page; issue #1615 lacks a named strict reader, native audit log, and independent geometry report. No runtime result or support claim is inferred.

sources.revision: Issue page reviewed 2026-10-18; page marked closed
sources.observed: The reporter describes BricsCAD reporting invalid AcDb:AcDsPrototype data and recovery removing numerous AcDb3dSolid records whose modeler streams were empty. The issue title references an older OCS version. The reviewed page provides no hash-bound output, exact effective writer revision/target version, or visible closure explanation demonstrating a fix.

sources.revision: Issue and comments reviewed 2026-10-18; issue remains open
sources.observed: A user reports initial AutoCAD/ProgeCAD failures for 3D DWG output and intermittent Boolean problems. A later comment describes improvement and one current-main Boolean result opening in an unnamed strict third-party reader. No reproducible hash, named reader/build, native AUDIT report, or independent shape metrics are present in the reviewed page.

sources.revision: Mutable main reviewed 2026-10-18; Cargo.toml declares app version 2026.41.0
sources.observed: Cargo.toml pins an acadrust-named codec from the opencadcodec Git repository at revision 5d4f11a, OpenCADKernel at a60f18f with its acis feature, and OpenCADGraph at d9f2aee. These declarations identify a composed application route; they are not a run or independent conformance result.

sources.revision: Mutable source/docs and v2026.41 release page reviewed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: The tessellation document says Solid3D, Region, Body, and Surface use a kernel B-rep-lift/face-triangulation path. The automation guide describes save_verified as write/reopen/version/manifest/reference checks with an output hash, and separately documents mcp_acceptance profiles for DWG 2000/2013/2018 plus DXF 2000 and a Windows reference-CAD read-only AUDIT script. The self-check is correlated with the application stack; the documented external script was not run and covers only its named route/profile.

assessment.planImpact: Refines existing AcDs and 3D writer/consumer checks: verify expected non-empty per-solid payloads and owner/index/key closure, then keep application self-verification, strict external parsing, native no-recovery/AUDIT, and independent geometry as separate result fields. No new implementation workstream or routine validation is added.

implementationReadyChecks: Reuse the existing AcDs/ACIS focused generated test owner; only add a focused non-empty-per-expected-solid assertion if current tests do not already prove it.

For expected-solid cases, bind each source handle and block owner through modeler handle, AcDs index/key/record, and exact payload length/hash; distinguish empty, missing, duplicate, unresolved, and intentionally unsupported states.
At the composed gate, run strict external open before recovery and report audit repairs/deletions, object identity, payload disposition, B-rep validity, and analytic metrics separately.
Treat save_verified and same-app reopen as internal consistency only; only count a named third-party/native run after capturing exact application/build, command, output hash, and diagnostics.
Do not make OpenCADStudio, its Windows-only reference script, a peer binary, a new fixture, or full-suite/native runs part of each implementation slice.
Keep J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 DEFERRED_EXTERNAL; none of these pages satisfies their external qualification or semantic evidence requirements.

workingTree.note: The shared worktree was already broadly dirty. This pass edited only the plan and added its research receipt; unrelated work was preserved.
